fields.title: Extend sync_model_prices.py with GitHub Copilot pricing source

handoff_package.objective: Extend tools/model-prices/sync_model_prices.py to merge a second upstream source — GitHub's copilot models-and-pricing.yml — into model_prices.json, so every model the runSubagent surface offers (notably MAI-Code-1-Flash) has a priced row and can be cost-ranked.
